title: Negative: four-stage diagram of two objects' positions, NNE climb and departure heading
description: Negative photostat (white on black) of a sighting diagram with struck-through CONFIDENTIAL stamps. Numbered stages (1)-(4) show small circles with typed notes, from "First one object was sighted, next, another one appeared" to "Objects began moving in a NNE direction and rapidly accelerating and climbing" and "In approximately 2 minutes objects had disappeared". Two north arrows and an N-S line with circles carry the annotation "left on this heading".
